focus_areas: Geometric consistency of the wheel arches and tires
Legibility and realism of the front license plate
Structural integrity of the window frames against the body
Spatial grounding of the vehicle on the road surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the front grille and headlights. Ensure the reflection in the windshield does not reveal impossible interior structures. Verify that the text on the license plate follows a valid alphanumeric pattern rather than being random noise. Critically assess the contact points between the tires and the ground for any floating or sinking artifacts.
image_description: A red minibus (resembling a Citroën C35 or similar vintage van) parked on an asphalt street. The vehicle features a boxy body, a large windshield, side windows along the passenger area, and a visible front grille with a logo. It has standard wheels and appears to be in good condition. There are some objects (hoses/cables) on the ground in the foreground.
